title: Raw-markup binding (javascript: <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: q}} />) — review required
description: A javascript template or component binds a value as raw markup: <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: q}} />. Untrusted input in the value runs as script in victims' browsers. This lexical rule flags the binding; the reviewer confirms the value is trusted or switches to text binding.
remediation: Bind the value as text (text children or DOMPurify.sanitize) or sanitize it against a tag allowlist before raw binding.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the binding regardless of value trust. Call-shaped sinks are separate rules.
